## Finding — `check-clause2-carriers --pair` reads an unreadable `Served-tier:` line only under a gate clear (C7); a non-gated pair with the same record passes exit 0

Filed by the `domain:skills` execution PM seat (#7623), session `session_01DAcomhvR9kKizeYgg89Vo8`, **2026-09-14T10:30Z**. Bare `finding`; keywords: `check-clause2-carriers`, `Served-tier`, C7, `contract-review.md`, declared ≠ enforced, `scripts/pm/**`.

### What was measured, same script, same day

| pair | gate hung? | record's `Served-tier:` line | `--pair` exit |
|---|---|---|---|
| objectstack PR #18157 / #17991 (record 5661052272) | no (`Clause-②` not declared `yes`) | `Served-tier: 2433/2444, then `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`` — the reader strips the stamp control, then finds no token because of the 「, then」 prose; the control is also NOT total | **0** |
| objectui PR #9486 / #9191 (record 5662548425) | yes, hung and cleared | `Served-tier: 10/10, then `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`` | **4**, C7: 「carries a `Served-tier:` line with no readable tier token」 |
| objectui PR #9486 / #9191 (record 5662557100) | yes | `Served-tier: 15/15 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`` — the template's live shape | **0** |

`readServedTier` (`scripts/pm/check-clause2-carriers.mjs`, the `SERVED_TIER_LINE` / `STAMP_CONTROL` / `TIER_TOKEN` readers) answers `unreadable` for the first spelling in both rows; only the C7 row surfaces it, and `c7ServedTierBelow(pair)` is consulted on the clear path. The self-test pins the live shape (「⭐ the LIVE value shape — stamp control, then the tier — reads at tier and stands」, `Served-tier: 75/75 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER``) and pins a NOT-total control as void; neither pin reaches a pair that never hung the gate.

### Why it matters

`references/contract-review.md` :29 rules 「同形含首行 `Served-tier:`:值写常量名 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`;无此行不成裁决,模板见 `--template`」 — a record whose line does not read is, by the rule, not a verdict at all. Yet the strip gate (`--pair` exit 0) let record 5661052272 stand as the review of record for a landing on `origin/main` (PR #18157 → `7e58d177ee`), and the seat only learned the shape was unreadable when a gated pair on another repo refused it. The same is true of the NOT-total stamp control (11 off-tier turns from a 2026-09-13 fallback window inside a whole-session count): 回退证据 by the rule, invisible on the non-gated path.

### Proposed shape (the dev decides)

- Evaluate the `Served-tier:` reading of the review of record on EVERY pair that has one (the C6-RECORD path already locates it), not only beside a gate clear; an unreadable or off-tier line is exit 4 with C7's text either way. The rule text already says so (「无此行不成裁决」); the checker enforces it on one path of two.
- Keep the remedy row as is: re-post the record in the identifier-free live shape; the NEWEST heading comment on the head governs.
- The seat's own correction is on the record: from this card on it spells `Served-tier: N/N `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`` with the count taken over the reviewing round's transcript, never a whole-session count that can carry a past fallback window.

### Duplicate check
